ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's $250M Feeding Our Future Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the individuals and organizations involved in the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including Aimee Bock and other key players.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore how the fraud was perpetrated
ideas.insight: This story could explore the scope and impact of the fraud, as well as the efforts to prosecute and prevent similar cases in the future.

ideas.title: $4.6M Daycare Fraud: A Growing Concern in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $4.6M daycare fraud scheme and its connections to other cases in Minnesota
ideas.angle: Explore the pattern of fraud in Minnesota's daycare industry
questions: How common is fraud in Minnesota's daycare industry?
What are the consequences for those affected?
ideas.insight: This story could examine the prevalence and impact of fraud in Minnesota's daycare industry, as well as efforts to prevent and prosecute such cases.
